pageTitle: "Wings of Fate's Course Intertwined" Wind Glider Issuance Details
name: Détails sur la distribution du planeur « Ailes des destins entremêlés »
description: Dear Traveler, To celebrate the launch of Genshin Impact on Xbox Series X<nowiki>|</nowiki>S, we have prepared a special gift for everyone — the Wind Glider "Wings of Fate's Course Intertwined." Please remember to claim it in time. Thank you for your support! <nowiki>*</nowiki>The Dressing Room feature can be unlocked through progressing in the game. You can equip the stylized wind glider once that feature is activated via the "Dressing Room > Wind Glider" interface.
